newsitem.title: USA: MedImmune says MEDI-493 Phase III trials positive.
newsitem.headline: MedImmune says MEDI-493 Phase III trials positive.

text.p: MedImmune Inc said on Wednesday that in the preliminary results of a Phase III clinical trial, its product MEDI-493 reduced the incidence of serious respiratory syncytial virus disease (RSV) in high-risk infants and children by 55 percent.
MedImmune said in a press release that it expects to submit by year-end an application to the U.S. Food and Drug Administration requesting marketing approval of MEDI-493.
The company also expects to submit regulatory applications to Canadian and European authorities in 1998.
The clinical trial was a randomized, placebo-controlled trial conducted on 1,502 high-risk infants at 139 clinical centers in the United States, Canada and the United Kingdom.
RSV is the most common cause of lower respiratory infections in infants and children worldwide, annually hospitalizing over 90,000 children and causing 4,500 deaths in the United States alone.
MedImmune is a biotech company developing products for infectious diseases and transplantation medicine.
